elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner
elements.evidence: "will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner"

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner
elements.evidence: "professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards"
"will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation" — conformance is qualified by materiality
"for a period of ninety (90) days following the Company's written acceptance"
the workmanlike/professional services warranty in (c)(1) carries no stated duration; the 90 days attaches only to Site conformance
"repair or replacement of the non-conforming portion of the Site"
"repair or replacement of the non-conforming portion of the Site"
"or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services"
"in compliance with all applicable laws, rules and regulations"
"will not contain any virus, worm, disabling code or other malicious code"

elements.element: 90-day period for software conformance to documentation (conformance not materiality-qualified)
elements.evidence: "ninety (90) days" period is present but conformance is diluted to "in all material respects"
no duration is stated for the (c)(1) services performance warranty
"re-performance ..., repair or replacement ..., or a refund of the fees paid"

reasons: Preferred fails: the software/Site conformance period is 90 days rather than 12 months, and no services warranty period is stated at all.
Preferred and fallback both fail on conformance scope: "conform in all material respects" dilutes the required documentation-conformance warranty.
Remedy election is given to the Vendor ("at HDI's option") and adds a re-performance option beyond the playbook set of repair, replace or refund, weakening the Customer's remedy.
Non-minimal additions: "consistent with industry standards" qualifies the professional/workmanlike standard and is not needed to complete the level.

Insertion itself is appropriately placed as new (c) for an absent performance warranty and does not disturb the mutual authority warranties or the Globix carve-out, so unrelated terms remain effective.
